time_scope: Observed worker interval through validation. Final timestamp insertion and handoff follow this cutoff. Concurrent agent intervals do not multiply campaign elapsed time.
activity: Read 19 current status records, focused cards, recent source/cost/numerical reports, and two retained C07 JSON records. Classify evidence and narrow unsupported interpretations.

status_snapshot.warning: These labels combine prior overlap, structural screens, scoped observations, and missing evidence. They are not 19 measured architecture failures.
status_snapshot.later_C07_record: The matrix snapshot predates the failed P1 fixture qualification. This audit adds an interpretation overlay, not a status edit.

categories.A: Direct relevant mechanism prior. Does not prove a ready Ouro runtime or no useful physical optimum.
categories.B: Measured scoped cost failure. Does not generalize beyond its implementation, workload, and timing contract.
categories.C: DAG expressibility or constructed trace equivalence. Physical trace equality is conditional on granted owners, state protocol, resources, kernels, and schedule.
categories.D: Missing evidence. Means unestablished, not failed.
categories.E: Analytic/structural result or measured non-cost predicate. Not a measured architecture latency failure.

cost_failure_boundary.C02: Real graph-captured isolated-source full-MLP round trips lose at tested rows1–512. Not every pooled owner layout.
cost_failure_boundary.C08: Measured raw/transform primitives concern an unfused small-message screen. They do not measure a complete fused codec or large-KV path.
cost_failure_boundary.C05: Measured actual-model recovery rounds plus modeled distributed costs, not a physical distributed solver timing failure.
cost_failure_boundary.C07: Measured fixture parity failure, not a service timing or architecture quality failure.
cost_failure_boundary.C19: Measured key frame sizes plus modeled read demand, not GPU latency.

focused_findings.valid_negative: Ordinary ready-task pooling has concrete priors. The stated ordinary complete-core on-chip capacity screen fails.
focused_findings.narrowing: Do not equate NanoFlow shared-pointer/operator support with a qualified complete Ouro runtime. Do not equate whole-core capacity failure with no useful partial retention.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A named retained subset or ownership change with legal current inputs and changed live bytes, transfers, and exposed path beyond same-resource TP/DP/generic pooling.
focused_findings.remaining_question: Whether repeated physical visits change the best selective retention/ownership plan under actual ready supply.

focused_findings.valid_negative: Specific local nonlinear computations on additive partial sums are invalid. The illustrated layout has no measured request saving.
focused_findings.narrowing: Required semantic dependencies do not imply complete-vector materialization at every rank. Reopening need not remove an entire message if bytes, startup, contention, or exposed synchronization decreases.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A consumer-compatible representation plus a named reduced cost, with every deferred gather/reduction/norm statistic and native numerical boundary charged.
focused_findings.remaining_question: A concrete layout/retention policy could change the physical optimum without changing the mathematical DAG.

focused_findings.valid_negative: Verified branches and shared-prefix primitives have direct priors. The P1 service fixture does not pass its initial exact-parity qualification.
focused_findings.narrowing: Do not report the unresolved fixture difference as architecture failure, quality loss, acceptance-rate loss, or valid service cost.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: First establish the first unequal operator boundary on the same selected input/history under a declared numerical contract. A qualified same-branch-work comparison must then charge tentative ancestors, rejection, commit, and strongest same-P execution.
focused_findings.remaining_question: Whether a distinct verified-state ownership protocol reduces exposed transfers or duplication while preserving useful verifier batching.

focused_findings.valid_negative: The arbitrary-real-query fixed small linear-feature claim fails its rank construction. Selected cross-depth keys resist unqualified exact-real pattern reuse.
focused_findings.narrowing: Neither result rejects every nonlinear/restricted representation, rounded coincidence, weighted-output equality, or approximate method. Retained authoritative full KV can defeat a capacity claim without disproving every faster exact read/fallback procedure.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A concrete exact or permitted explicitly approximate query algorithm, with summary size, update/fallback cost, required KV, backend numerics, gate/publication semantics, and complete physical cost.
focused_findings.remaining_question: A specified exact nonlinear/read structure or a permitted approximation might create useful query work. No qualifying structure currently exists.

focused_findings.valid_negative: Generic cyclic/tied primitives exist. Granting identical physical owners, state protocol, kernels, messages, and schedule makes the compared trace identical. Balanced dense-core and final KV capacities match TP4 under the stated accounting.
focused_findings.narrowing: The trace construction is conditional, not a stock Ouro implementation or latency measurement. A changed mathematical dependency is not necessary to reopen a distinct retention, transient-buffer, or placement optimum. C1 prompt chunks remain a legal prefill frontier.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A physical cost difference outside the granted identical trace, with a legal complete chunk/depth schedule and comparison against tied-aware cyclic PP and native TP under the same capacity/numerics.
focused_findings.remaining_question: Whether selective retention, scratch lifetimes, or communication/compute overlap changes a measured cyclic-versus-TP optimum. A generic PP win alone does not establish a new axis.

focused_findings.valid_negative: The constructed mixed-depth union has no additional ready width beyond generic union.
focused_findings.narrowing: Equal ready sets do not prove equal message cost, queueing, useful utilization, or future readiness. An identical trace is a local service control, not a substitute for schedule-dependent completion/gate feedback in E2E execution.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A changed cross-owner cost on identical useful work, then a self-consistent schedule under common arrivals and semantics. Charge all routing, wait, idle-device, KV, and gate publication costs against generic union and same-P TP/DP/disaggregation.
focused_findings.remaining_question: A physical owner-placement benefit can exist without a new union-width mechanism. None is currently measured.

focused_findings.valid_negative: Deferred norm scaling has a direct prior. The simple BF16 rewrite is not universally word-exact.
focused_findings.narrowing: A local cast counterexample is not a model-quality failure or rejection of every qualified numerical path. R1 generic value does not numerically predict full R4 amortization/contention.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A backend-qualified path plus a named retained-byte, setup-reuse, or cross-owner effect beyond ordinary fusion. Charge tile publication, scratch, reductions, occupancy, synchronization, and actual revisit lifetimes.
focused_findings.remaining_question: Whether a genuine physical retention or setup effect remains after a competent same-transform generic baseline.

focused_findings.valid_negative: Selected keys reconstruct exactly after CPU coding. Under separate uncached reconstruction, the modeled shared-base/chain read demand increases.
focused_findings.narrowing: Replace the interpretation of no latency headroom with no read-volume advantage under the stated model. No GPU timing or HBM result exists. Key-only selected frames do not establish full K+V behavior.
focused_findings.reopening_fact: A legal base/page ownership and retention lifetime that changes repeated reads without simultaneous future queries, charging full K+V, decoder/append/metadata/scratch costs and independent compression/adaptive alias controls. A capacity claim needs a real admission boundary.
focused_findings.remaining_question: A selective retained-base or capacity-admission mechanism remains logically possible but unmeasured.

recent_screen_interpretations.narrowing: Direct caching/AFD priors and no identified ownership discriminator justify no card. No combined cost or task-quality failure was measured. This does not authorize stale-family reopening or a quality run.

No future recurrent input means no depth-readiness shortcut. It does not alone reject an operator-cost or ownership improvement. Direct priors and missing physical distinction remain the stopping reasons.
The demand for a reuse unavailable to generic restoration should mean a concrete physical benefit beyond the matched control, not logical inexpressibility in a general executor.

C07_raw_record_crosscheck.RPC_limit: Includes parity, restoration, barriers, and repeats. Not one-pass service latency.
C07_raw_record_crosscheck.interpretation: Fixture qualification failure with unresolved cause, not candidate quality or cost failure.

remaining_conditional_physical_questions: Can a named shared-weight/scratch/loop-boundary subset remain resident over actual revisits and alter the best ownership plan?
Can authoritative current or verified-branch state reduce exposed transfers/duplication without losing useful batch efficiency?
remaining_question_limit: These are questions within existing families. They are not finalists, new cards, positive headroom evidence, or authorization for new execution.
